headAtlases.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset: transparent game HEAD SPRITE ATLAS, exactly the same 4-column 3-row grid as input, each cell 512x512 in a 2048x1536 canvas. Edit target: supplied atlas. Remove ALL eyes, pupils, eyebrows, noses, beaks, mouths, teeth and facial-expression strokes completely from EVERY head. Fill removed details seamlessly using the underlying skin/material color and shading. Keep character order, per-cell positions, theme colors, accessories, top ornaments, thick black outer lines, soft original shading and transparency. Empty cells MUST stay empty. NO text, labels, borders, grid lines, extra objects. Redesign every face as a front-facing round ball / round oval, with identical size and alignment of the blank face area across all cells, center around (256,295) in each 512px cell. NO dog/cat muzzle, NO projecting snout, no side profile, no pale muzzle patch; face is a broad smooth uninterrupted circular surface. Keep theme ears, horns, crystals, crown or antennae only on the TOP of the round head. Keep face surface broad and clear from x=110 to 402 and y=190 to 410, for two interchangeable eyes and a mouth to be added later. These are blank head bases, not characters with closed eyes. NO facial features of any kind.

Keep head outline, exact shape, size, placement, colors and all other body/arm/leg parts unchanged. Preserve original 1500x1700 composition and transparent background. facePartsPrompt: Create one production facial PARTS sprite atlas. Reference image is ONLY for its cartoon eye style, thick smooth black outlines, friendly big oval eyes and smile. Do not draw a character or head. Transparent background. Exactly SIX isolated sprites in a 3 column by 2 row grid, each sprite centered within its cell with generous transparent padding. Canvas 1536x1024. Top row: (1) a single vertical oval white eye sclera with thick black outline, NO pupil; (2) a single solid black oval pupil with ONE small white oval shine near its upper right, NO white sclera or eye outline; (3) a simple black U-shaped smiling mouth, thick rounded ends, no surrounding face. Bottom row: (1) a left hurt squeezed-shut eye shaped like > with thick rounded black strokes, no white fill; (2) a right hurt squeezed-shut eye shaped like < with thick rounded black strokes, no white fill; (3) a small open oval hurt mouth, thick black outline with dark interior and small pink tongue at bottom. Flat 2D game art, clean antialiasing. No shadows, text, grid lines, labels, characters, heads, duplicates, eyebrows, noses or extra elements. All six objects fully isolated and non-touching. Eye sclera in first cell must be completely white with NO pupil so a movable pupil can be overlaid later.
